remark: Seasons of Use 'Open Season: April - October'. Chip opens 04-15 is the start of reservations; Apr 1-14 the whole campground is first-come. Booking season 04-15 to 10-31. 'Site Closed / Closed for the winter.' header is the normal off-season.

quote: 2026: May 1 - October 31  -  Reservations available through recreation.gov
remark: Current Conditions line. Chip closes 09-17 is ~6 weeks early. Page disagrees with entry: '44 of these single unit sites and the group site are available through reservations. All other single unit sites are first-come, first-served.' (entry booking has no fcfs); posted max length 'up to 38 feet long' (note says 45 ft); page says 94 single sites (note 77 + 10 doubles); water system currently off, temporary fill station.

FS page has no Seasons of Use / open-season line (only 'Site Open'); forest camping list page has none either. Recreation.gov 232204 text says only 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting, please call 928-537-8888'. Rec.gov notices mention FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites booked in person (entry booking has no fcfs).

Seasons of Use gives only an opening date (May 15); no closing date stated, so the chip's closes 09-17 is neither confirmed nor contradicted (same pattern as 11350). Page: 'Campsites 130 thru 152 (loop F) are available on a first come first serve bases'. Recreation.gov 232200: 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting'.

remark: Same month at the open edge (chip 05-14 vs early May); agency also states a mid-October close the chip lacks. 'Early-May' read as 05-01, so the chip may be ~2 weeks late (15 of 30 sites are first-come). Page: '15 sites are reservable, and 15 sites are on a first-come, first-served basis.'

Page: 'Reservations are only available during late spring through early fall. Walk-in campers can self-register at the entrance.' and 'Some sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis.' (entry booking has no fcfs). Chip closes 09-14 is the end of reservations. Page says 38 campsites (note ~39).

FS page has no Seasons of Use line (Operational Hours 'Open 24 hours/day'); it lists 'Winter Rates' (suggesting winter operation) and 'Water system is anticipated to be turned back on for Memorial Day Weekend.' Recreation.gov 233347 text states no season. Rec.gov notes 'Site 1 is the only electrical site'; 'Average maximum trailer size is 36 feet'.

remark: Open edge agrees (May / May 15). Close edge given two ways: Seasons of Use 'October' (10-31) vs Operational Hours 'September/October', so left out. Chip closes 09-07 is Labor Day (holiday-anchored), likely the end of reservations: 'Forty-five sites, #15-#42 and #57-#75, are designated walk-in sites'.

Chip closes 09-26 is 18 days before the stated close; entry has some FCFS sites, so the calendar edge is the end of reservations. Entry website is only the forest home page; this is the campground's own page. 'Site Closed' header is the normal off-season. Page note '5/3/24: Camp open, but only non-potable water available'.
